# Mercury transaction categorization

`GRADED` `PROPOSES-WRITES` `HUMAN-APPROVAL`

Mercury's own skill that suggests expense categories for uncategorized Mercury transactions and applies the ones you approve. The repository has no licence file.

**What it can do:** Changes records only after you approve.

## Why these badges

- **`PROPOSES-WRITES`** — Writes categories to Mercury transactions, only from the organisation's own category list.
- **`HUMAN-APPROVAL`** — "Updates are written one transaction at a time and always require user confirmation before any write."
